conversation.user: Is hempcrete cheaper than drywall and fiberglass?
conversation.assistant:
Upfront, hemp-lime materials are about 15-20% more expensive than standard drywall and fiberglass batts because it serves as your insulation, vapor management, and rigid wall finish all in one 4-in-1 assembly. Over time, you often save money through 30-40% lower HVAC bills and extreme durability, which typically pays off that initial difference within 3 to 5 years. 

Are you looking at this for a new build or a renovation project?
